attr.title: Digimon World 3: Definitive Edition
attr.desc: Digimon World 3: Definitive Edition — a native RK3326 source port of Digimon World 2003 (PAL, SLES-03936) with Persona-style elemental weakness combat, rebalanced progression, Hunt/Forge/Black Market/DRI systems, and an in-game Guide, with GLES 3D rendering and a byte-exact software rasteriser.
attr.inst: Needs your own disc: Digimon World 2003 (Europe/PAL, SLES-03936). Copy the .cue AND the .bin into ports/dw3/game/ (on EmuELEC that is /storage/roms/ports/dw3/game/) - any .cue/.bin pair works, the launcher finds it. Do not rename the .bin without editing the .cue. Nothing of the game ships with the port.
